name: Integer Programming / Transportation and Assignment Problem
when_to_use: Optimization problem (complements 23-programacao-linear/23-metodo-simplex) where the solution must be in whole numbers (not fractional), or a classic distribution problem between origins and destinations at minimum cost.
notes: Complements the already cataloged Linear Programming/Simplex for when the solution must be in whole numbers (not fractional) or is a classic distribution problem. Applications: team allocation, routing, distribution between factories and distribution centers.

expected_input.question: What is the minimum-cost allocation/distribution, given that the solution must be integer?

pdca_use: Plan phase: minimum-cost allocation/distribution between origins and destinations (e.g., teams, inventory) when the solution must be in whole units — same deterministic nature as the Simplex.

plain_explanation.purpose: Plans what to ship from where to where at the lowest cost, in whole quantities.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are origins, destinations, route costs and limits.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Cost per route, supply of each origin and demand of each destination.
plain_explanation.example: Decide which factory supplies which distribution center.
plain_explanation.diagram: factories -> routes with cost -> centers (lowest total cost)
